summary: Ten-League International Holdings Limited furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, plus an earnings press release. Revenue fell 12.2% year over year to S$33.1 million (US$25.6 million), as heavy equipment and parts sales dropped 41.1% to S$18.1 million, partly offset by engineering consultancy income of S$8.6 million tied to delivery of 30 electric prime movers and rental income of S$6.4 million. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no deal, stake, or board recommendation exists. Watch operational turnaround, ePM deliveries, and rental demand.
